note: ASSET-MAP-FRAME-002 = the heavy map frame of the map-image boards (review gap 9, full fix). Every number is PROPOSED (lane K), not an art decision. Frame footprint = the current one: inner opening = the map (S08MapImageSpec HalfUU, 1337 x 866 px x 0.6666667 uu/px), wood out to FrameHalfUU = map half + frameUU 24 (S08BoardArt.h DefaultFrameUU); the camera, the tray fit (S08Diorama::T2MinApronUU) and the env layouts keep their numbers. Heavier = a 1.6x taller profile (14 -> 22.4 uu: z -10 .. +12.4; the bars today are cubes 24 x 14 uu centred on z -3, i.e. -10 .. +4) with a raised, bevelled outer rail, a stepped inner lip and iron hardware.
